messages.text: What is measurement method, and which product-related measurement decisions depend on understanding it?

### Short answer
The passages use “measurement method” as the concrete way a test result is obtained: the raw source labels the test method as “Measurement” for an “expected nominal power setting for full dynamic range,” while RSE examples spell out methods such as substitution, EIRP coarse-grid search, and TRP fine-grid/final evaluation [100][37][8][44].
### What the method can mean in these passages
| Measurement-method concept | What the passages state |
|---|---|
| Substitution method | For RSE, the reference method is substitution: the DUT is replaced by a calibrated antenna with a signal generator, the generator level is tuned to the same receive value as the DUT, and EIRP is calculated by adding antenna gain and cable loss [37]. |
| EIRP / TRP method | R&S ELEKTRA supports 3D EIRP evaluation by measuring Effective Isotropic Radiated Power instead of field strength, while 5G FR2 sources often express the test requirement using TRP [8]. |
| Two-step EIRP→TRP method | The 5G FR2 RSE two-step method first uses an EIRP coarse grid to identify spurious frequencies, then performs TRP on a fine grid for frequencies where EIRP is above the limit [44]. |
| Raw product-test label | One raw passage only states “Expected nominal power setting for full dynamic range / Test method / Measurement,” without giving a fuller definition [100]. |
### Product-related measurement decisions that depend on understanding it
| Decision | Why the measurement method matters | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Whether to use ELEKTRA 3D EIRP / ELEMI-3D | ELEMI-3D is tied to measuring EIRP instead of field strength, supporting SAC and FAR 3D measurement, elevation positioner, spherical elevation or cylindrical height scan, and 3D result presentation [1]. | [1] |
| Whether substitution support is needed in ELEKTRA | ELEKTRA supports the RSE substitution method, whose procedure replaces the DUT with a calibrated antenna and signal generator and calculates EIRP from antenna gain and cable loss [37]. | [37] |
| Whether the RSE result should be EIRP or TRP | The passages distinguish 3D EIRP evaluation from FR2 RSE requirements often expressed as TRP, and describe final measurements that can calculate 2-cut TRP, 3-cut TRP, or full TRP [8]. | [8] |
| Whether to use TS8980 or TS8996 for FR2 RSE scope | For 5G FR2, 3GPP validated tests with R&S ATS1800C are mapped to R&S TS8980, while broader ETSI / FCC RSE requirements are mapped to R&S TS8996 [46]. | [46] |
| Which chamber / scan setup to use in TS8996-style RSE | RSE setup can use FAR with azimuth and optional elevation scan, or SAC with height scan; common test distance is 3 m, and 1 m can be used to improve sensitivity [47]. | [47] |
| Whether to use a spectrum analyzer or EMI receiver | The passages state that RSE can use a spectrum analyzer or EMI receiver, RF analysis needs a spectrum analyzer, and EMC test standards need an EMI receiver [47][56]. | [47][56] |
| Which FSW operating mode to choose for base-station Tx tests | Spectrum mode is used for OBW and transmitter spurious emissions, while 5G NR mode is used for EVM/Frequency Err/Power, Time Alignment Error, Transmit ON/OFF Power, Channel Power ACLR, and SEM [79]. | [79] |
| Whether to apply virtual RMS detector bandwidths | ELEKTRA supports virtual RMS detectors with 100 MHz and 200 MHz bandwidth that integrate lower-bandwidth measurements over a sliding window for FR2 RSE limits [3][5]. | [3][5] |

passages.text:
R&S ELEKTRA › 3D EIRP Evaluation / ELEMI-3D
依 [[RSE Test System TS8996 (1)]]：

- 量測 [[EIRP]]（Effective Isotropic Radiated Power）instead of field strength。
- 支援 SAC and FAR 3D measurement。
- 支援 elevation positioner。
- 支援 spherical elevation 或 cylindrical height scan。
- 支援 3D result presentation。
- option 名稱為 [[ELEMI-3D]]。

R&S ELEKTRA
[[R&S ELEKTRA]] 是 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 的 EMC / RSE test automation software；[[Regulatory test for wireless devices with cellular technology]] 只把它列為 [[R&S TS8996]] RSE & customization 的 solution mapping，[[RSE Test System TS8996 (1)]]（07/2025）則描述它在 [[Radiated Spurious Emissions]]、[[5G FR2 RSE 測試]]、wireless EMC / EMS 與報告管理中的具體功能。

R&S ELEKTRA › 5G FR2 test procedure support
依 [[RSE Test System TS8996 (1)]]：

- ELEKTRA is next generation EMC test SW。
- For 5G support of RSE measurement procedures with extension for 5G FR2。
- 支援 3D and TRP evaluation。
- 支援 5G signaling with [[R&S CMX500]]。
- Mixers and calibration procedure also supported by EMC32。
- EMI test sequence adopted to support RSE requirements。
- Sweeps 可 free run（for FDD）或 gated sweep（triggered by CMX, for TDD）。
- 支援 elevation positioner。
- 支援 3D view possibility for overview measurement, maximization and final TRP measurement。
- Typical test distance: **1 m for >40 GHz** and **3 m for <40 GHz**。
- Workflow steps 包含 overview measurement、data reduction、maximization、adjustment、final measurement。
- Virtual RMS detectors with **100 MHz and 200 MHz bandwidth** 可把 lower bandwidth measurement integration over 100 MHz / 200 MHz sliding window，用於平行量測 -13 dBm/MHz 與 -10 dBm/100 MHz limits。

5G FR2 RSE 測試 › FCC / ANSI C63.26 口徑
依 [[RSE Test System TS8996 (1)]]：

- ANSI C63.26 RSE frequency ranges：
  - RF signal <10 GHz: 10th harmonic, max. 40 GHz。
  - RF signal <30 GHz: 5th harmonic, max. 100 GHz。
  - RF signal >30 GHz: 5th harmonic, max. 200 GHz。
- FCC 47 CFR Part 30, KDB 842590 and ANSI C63.26：
  - 30 MHz up to 5th harmonic / 100 GHz（devices <30 GHz）或 200 GHz（devices >30 GHz）。
  - Limit -13 dBm。
  - Method: TRP。
  - Early exit criteria for EIRP, TRP only for failing frequencies。
  - Test distance formula 在來源中 OCR 為 `≥ 2D2/`，公式不完整，需回查原文。
- 來源稱 FCC requires 30 MHz to 5th harmonic / 200 GHz and semi anechoic chamber → [[R&S TS8996]]。

⚠️ [[RSE Test System TS8996 (1)]]（07/2025）說 FCC 5G FR2 RSE requirement starts at 30 MHz up to 5th harmonic / 100 GHz or 200 GHz，但既有頁面 [[FCC 無線設備法規測試]] 說 5G NR FR2 FCC analyzer frequency range 是 9 kHz–200 GHz。判斷：兩者可能分別是 test requirement lower bound 與 analyzer / general spectrum investigation range 口徑；未回查 47 CFR、KDB 842590 與 ANSI C63.26 前並列保留。

5G FR2 RSE 測試 › ELEKTRA workflow
依 [[RSE Test System TS8996 (1)]]：

1. Overview measurement：scan over complete sphere, wide frequency subrange, continuous azimuth / elevation, V / H polarisation。
2. Data reduction：detect critical frequencies，limit check，例如 FCC 20 dB below limit (-33 dBm/MHz) as early pass / fail criteria。
3. Maximization：high-resolution maximum EIRP search over complete sphere。
4. Adjustment：loop over azimuth, elevation, polarization H / V / +45° / -45°, x-y variation of test antenna。
5. Final measurement：2 orthogonal cuts, 3rd orthogonal cut, 2-cut / 3-cut TRP, if limit exceeded full TRP。

[[R&S ELEKTRA]] also supports virtual RMS detectors with 100 MHz and 200 MHz bandwidth, integrating lower-bandwidth measurements over a sliding window for ETSI -10 dBm/100 MHz limit.

5G FR2 RSE 測試 › ETSI / CE RED 口徑
依 [[RSE Test System TS8996 (1)]]：

- ETSI 301 908-25 draft covers RSE for 5G FR2。
- 來源說該 draft in line with [[ERC Recommendation 74-01]]（1998, amended 29 May 2019）。
- Limits table：

| Frequency range | Maximum level (TRP) | Measurement bandwidth |
|---|---:|---:|
| 30 MHz to 1 GHz | -36 dBm | 100 kHz |
| 1 GHz to 7.25 GHz | -30 dBm | 1 MHz |
| 7.25 GHz to 2nd harmonic | -13 dBm | 1 MHz |
| 7.25 GHz to 2nd harmonic | -10 dBm | 100 MHz |

- Above 7.25 GHz both limits are simultaneously applicable。
- Smaller resolution bandwidth with integration over measurement bandwidth is allowed。
- OOB boundary from edge of channel bandwidth：50 MHz channel BW → 100 MHz；100 MHz → 200 MHz；200 MHz → 400 MHz；400 MHz → 800 MHz。
- 來源說 ETSI covers only devices with highest power class 3。
- 來源稱 ETSI requires start at 30 MHz and additional limit -10 dBm/100 MHz (-30 dBm/MHz) → [[R&S TS8996]]。

Radiated Spurious Emissions › 使用限制
- 本頁不是任何標準的正式定義。
- RSE limits、frequency range、detector、RBW / VBW、test distance、antenna、grid 與 pass / fail criteria 必須依具體標準與產品類別判定。
- 本頁目前主要是 R&S solution / Market 簡報抽取，不可替代 [[FCC]]、[[ETSI]]、[[3GPP]]、[[ANSI C63.26]] 或 [[ERC Recommendation 74-01]] 原文。

Radiated Spurious Emissions › RSE 與 EIRP / TRP
依 [[RSE Test System TS8996 (1)]]：

- [[R&S ELEKTRA]] 支援 3D [[EIRP]] evaluation：量測 Effective Isotropic Radiated Power instead of field strength。
- 5G FR2 來源多以 [[TRP]] method 表示 test requirement。
- ETSI 301 908-25 draft 來源描述 two-step method：先用 EIRP coarse grid 找 spurious frequencies，再對 EIRP above limit 的 frequencies 執行 TRP fine grid。
- Final measurement 可計算 2-cut TRP、3-cut TRP；若 limit exceeded，另執行 full TRP。

Radiated Spurious Emissions
[[Radiated Spurious Emissions]]（RSE）是無線裝置在載波與必要頻寬之外，以輻射方式發出的 unwanted emissions 測試項目；本 vault 目前主要由 [[Regulatory test for wireless devices with cellular technology]] 與 [[RSE Test System TS8996 (1)]] 支撐。

RSE Test System TS8996 (1) › 關鍵實體與概念
- [[R&S TS8996]]：RSE test system，本來源補足 basic setup、frequency ranges、signal conditioning、FR2 extension、TS8980 differentiation 與 up to 325 GHz 的 system extension。

這份 2025/07 company restricted 簡報介紹 [[R&S TS8996]] Radiated Spurious Emission（[[Radiated Spurious Emissions]]）test system，涵蓋 2G / 3G / 4G / [[5G NR]] FR1、WLAN、Bluetooth，以及 5G FR2 最高到 220 GHz / 325 GHz 的 RSE 測試擴充方案。

| Wi-Fi & Co. in unlicensed bands | [[47 CFR §15]] C / E；2.4 GHz ISM band §15.247 & [[KDB558074]]；5 GHz U-NII bands §15.407 / .247 & [[KDB789033]] / [[KDB905462]] DFS；6 GHz U-NII(5-8) §15.407 & [[KDB987594]] |
| Ultra Wideband | [[47 CFR §15F]] Ultra-Wideband Operation |

- [[ANSI C63.26]]：Compliance Testing of Transmitters Used in the Licensed Radio Service。
- [[ANSI C63.10]]：Compliance Testing of Unlicensed Wireless Devices。
- [[IEEE Std 1528-2013]]：SAR measurement techniques。
- [[C63.19]]：Hearing Aid Compatibility。

Regulatory test for wireless devices with cellular technology › 重點摘要
- 來源將 wireless products 的 market access approval testing 分成三類：[[Regulatory Compliance Test]]、[[Telecom Industry Certification Test]]、[[Cellular Network Operator Acceptance Test]]。Regulatory compliance 被描述為各區域法律面 market access 的必要條件；industry certification 例子包含 [[GCF]] / Cellular、[[Bluetooth SIG]]、[[FiRa]] / [[UWB]]、[[Wi-Fi Alliance]]；operator acceptance test 例子包含 AT&T、VzW、T-mobile、CMCC。
- 來源主張 wireless products 需要 [[CE marking]] / [[FCC ID]]；test results 是 technical documentation 的一部分，需在產品投放市場前準備、可提供給 surveillance authorities，並自 placed on the market 起保存 10 years。
- 來源列出 Ericsson Mobility Visualizer Jan 2023 的 mobile subscriptions 表，顯示 2022–2028 的 5G subscriptions 由 1046.006 增至 4974.568；但單位與表格數值口徑未在轉檔文字中完整標示。
- [[CE RED 無線設備法規測試]]被整理成四類 essential requirements：Art 3.1a Health & Safety、Art 3.1b EMC、Art 3.2 Radio Spectrum、Art 3.3 Specific topics。來源列出多個 ETSI EN standards，例如 [[EN 300 328]]、[[EN 301 893]]、[[EN 303 687]]、[[EN 301 908-1]]、[[EN 301 908-13]]、[[EN 301 908-24]]、[[EN 301 908-25]]、[[EN 301 489-52]] 等。
- 對 [[5G NR SAR testing]]，來源指出 5G NR network emulator is required to drive EUT to extreme transmission condition，multi-radio UE 的 average-SAR feature 需要 flexible signaling functions，涵蓋 cellular standards、Wi-Fi 與 Bluetooth；來源將 [[R&S CMW500]] / [[R&S CMX500]] 稱為 SAR / HAC signaling solution。
- 對 Art 3.1b EMC，來源指出 EMC tests 需要 radio enabled 與 radio disabled conditions，因此 5G NR 也需要 signaling solution；mobile phone 仍需要 [[Audio Breakthrough]] test，從 GSM 到 VoLTE / VoNR by 5G。來源提到 [[R&S TS9982 EMS Test System]] 與 [[R&S TS9975 EMI Test System]]。
- 對 Art 3.2 Radio Spectrum，來源指出 5G NR specification 包含 FR1 與 FR2；FR1 test setup stays conducted，FR2 test setup becomes radiated；並把 3GPP test cases、CTIA-OTA test cases、TRP / TRS、RSE 測試連到 [[R&S TS8991]] 與 [[R&S TS8996]]。

FR2 OTA spatial test metrics › EIRP @ Beam Peak / TX Beam Peak metric
來源文字：

- EIRP metric：In best TX beam peak direction measure power。
- TX Beam peak metric：Same as EIRP but non-power measurement, e.g. EVM。
- For chapter 6 the beam peak is Tx beam peak = 100%-tile of EIRP CDF = strongest beam。

因此在此來源中：

- Power measurement at strongest TX beam 可用 [[EIRP]] @ beam peak。

來源文字：

- TRP metric – two antennas required, link + measurement。
- Lock the beam in best TX beam。
- Measure power per grid point。
- Calculate average。

GFM313_3e_5G_NR_BaseStation_Tx_Tests › 標準與測試範圍
來源說 [[3GPP]] 負責標準化，並在 [[3GPP TS 38.141]] 定義 NR [[Base Station]] RF conformance test methods and requirements，涵蓋：

- transmitter（Tx）
- receiver（Rx）
- performance（Px）

[[3GPP TS 38.141]] 依測試方法分為兩部分：

- [[3GPP TS 38.141-1]] Part 1：Conducted conformance testing。
- [[3GPP TS 38.141-2]] Part 2：Radiated conformance testing。

來源引用的 literature：

- [[3GPP TS 38.141-1]] Release 16 V16.3.0（2020）：NR Base station conformance testing, Part 1: Conducted conformance testing。
- [[3GPP TS 38.141-2]] Release 16 V16.3.0（2020）：NR Base Station conformance testing Part 2: Radiated conformance testing。
- [[3GPP TS 38.104]] Release 16 V16.3.0（2020）：NR Base Station radio transmission and reception。
- Rohde & Schwarz, 5G NR Technology Introduction（2019）。
- Rohde & Schwarz, Remote Control and Instrument Drivers。
- Rohde & Schwarz, Introducing SCPI Commands。

GFM313_3e_5G_NR_BaseStation_Tx_Tests › 適用產品
來源列出適用產品：

- [[R&S FSW]]
- [[R&S FSV3000]]
- [[R&S FSVA3000]]
- [[R&S FSV]]
- [[R&S FSVA]]
- [[R&S FPS]]
- [[R&S SMW200A]]
- [[R&S SMBV100B]]

可用於文件測試的 Rohde & Schwarz signal and spectrum analyzers 包含：

- [[R&S FSW]]
- [[R&S FSV3000]] and [[R&S FSVA3000]]
- [[R&S FSV]] and [[R&S FSVA]]
- [[R&S FPS]]
- [[R&S VSE Signal Analysis Software]]

GFM313_3e_5G_NR_BaseStation_Tx_Tests › 6.5.4 Time alignment error（TAE）
- TAE 定義為任兩個 NR signals 之間最大的 timing difference。
- Requirement 適用於 Tx diversity、MIMO transmission、carrier aggregation 及其組合的 frame timing。

TAE limits：

- MIMO / Tx diversity at each carrier frequency：90 ns。
- Intra-band CA with or without MIMO or Tx diversity：285 ns。
- Intra-band non-contiguous CA with or without MIMO or Tx diversity：3.025 μs。
- Inter-band CA with or without MIMO or Tx diversity：3.025 μs。

測試 setup：

- DUT 通常以 NR-FR1-TM1.1 搭配 MIMO transmission 或 carrier aggregation transmitting。
- 待量測 antennas 透過一個或多個 cascaded hybrid couplers 連接。
- FSW 透過 attenuator 連接。
- RF cables 應具有相同 electrical length。
- 最多可 parallel 量測 4 antennas。
- 量測基於個別 antennas 的 reference signal DM-RS。
- PDSCHs 會被忽略。
- 量測永遠相對於一個 reference antenna。

Drone EMC 測試 › 定義與範圍
依 [[2025RS Drone Solution]]，drone 可在 residential、outdoor AUT、commercial / industrial、security / emergency 與 military battle environment 中運作；不同環境有不同干擾強度與干擾型態，因此 EMC 測試需要依 intended environment and usage 定義。

來源列出的環境與干擾線索包含：

- residential environment：lighting、TV and sound systems、mobile devices、computers。
- AUT outdoor environment：navigation / GPS emissions、lightning or other EMP、mobile radio（GSM、UMTS、CDMA 2000、WCDMA）、communication equipment（GPS、radio）、broadcast emissions（DAB、VHF、DAV-B / 未決）、UHF、data communications、power supply、WiMax。
- MIL battle environment：multi-domain operations 與 complex electromagnetic environment。

Drone EMC 測試 › 測試配置線索
[[2025RS Drone Solution]] 提到：

- conducted layout：ground plane、EUT。
- radiated layout：frequency range 80 MHz – 6 GHz。
- drone mounting for radiated RF emission / immunity test：horizontal mounting 與 vertical mounting。
- mode of operation：idle mode 與 active mode。

來源指出 photo credit to Alex Bergdahl EMC of Unmanned AC，但未提供正式 citation、圖片內容 OCR 或測試方法細節。

Drone EMC 測試 › Class A / Class B emission limit
[[2025RS Drone Solution]] 以 [[CISPR 32]] equipment classification 說明：

- Class A：other than residential。
- Class B：residential。
- Class B emission limits are more stringent than Class A。
- Class B intended to be used in close vicinity to other devices。

來源用 DJI Phantom 與 Ring Always Home Cam 作為 photo credit / image context，但未提供其測試結果或產品符合性文件。

R&S ELEKTRA › Substitution method
依來源：

- RSE measurement including substitution 的 reference method 為 substitution。
- DUT replaced by a calibrated antenna with signal generator。
- Signal generator level tuned to same receive value as DUT。
- EIRP calculated by adding antenna gain and cable loss。
- Supported by ELEKTRA。

R&S ELEKTRA › unresolved
- 正式 datasheet、software version、licensing 與 supported standard list 未取得。
- [[ELEMI-EAS]]、[[ELEMI-RSE]]、[[ELEMI-3D]]、[[ELEMI-5GFC]]、[[ELEMI-OOB]] 等 options 的 order numbers、dependencies 與 release availability 未標示。
- 與 [[R&S ESW]]、[[R&S FSW]]、[[R&S TS8996]]、[[R&S TS9982 EMS Test System]] 的配置角色仍需正式 system documentation 補證。
- Satellite / NTN RSE customization 的交付方式與限制未標示。
- [[ELEMS-ABT]] audio breakthrough application note 未擷取正文。

R&S ELEKTRA › SAC height-scan correction
依來源：

- FAR precalibrated measurement 中 antenna height、DUT height、test distance constant，因此 free space loss constant。
- SAC precalibrated measurement 中 DUT height and horizontal test distance constant，但 effective test distance depends on antenna height。
- ELEKTRA can correct this test distance variation automatically。

R&S ELEKTRA › Wireless EMC / EMS extension
[[RSE Test System TS8996 (1)]] 另列出 wireless EMC / EMS 相關功能：

- Wireless EMC Extension: EMI tests for wireless devices；radiated and conducted emission test according ETSI EN 301 489；signaling also in EMI measurements supported。
- EMS tests for wireless devices：susceptibility tests according [[TS 134.124]] and ETSI EN 301 489。
- Signaling options include link quality measurement for wireless devices with data application，例如 BER、BLER、FER、PER。
- Radiated EMS tests for wireless devices with audio：susceptibility tests according TS 134.124 and ETSI EN 301 489；audio measurement for wireless devices with audio functionality。
- ELEKTRA option [[ELEMS-ABT]]；uses external audio analyzer or CMW internal audio analyzer；application note available with detailed setup description。

R&S ELEKTRA › Multi-band measurement
依來源：

- ELEKTRA Multi Band Measurement 可 speed up overview measurement by running up to **4 antennas / receivers** in parallel。
- 可 simultaneously measure up to **4 frequency subranges**。

5G FR2 RSE 測試 › 使用限制
- 本頁主要依 [[RSE Test System TS8996 (1)]] 這份 2025/07 Market 簡報整理，不是 standards text。
- ETSI 301 908-25 來源仍標示 draft；需回查正式 ETSI 文件與 harmonized standard status。
- FCC / ANSI C63.26 / KDB 842590 的公式、frequency range、early exit criteria 與 test distance 需回正式文件確認。
- TS8980 / TS8996 分工是 R&S solution positioning，不等同第三方 certification scope。
- `-13 dBm`、`-13 dBm/MHz`、`-10 dBm/100 MHz` 在來源不同 slide 使用，引用時需保留 slide context，不可混用。

5G FR2 RSE 測試 › 3GPP / RAN4 口徑
依 [[RSE Test System TS8996 (1)]]：

- 3GPP / RAN4 RSE specification: **9 kHz to 2nd harmonic**。
- RSE test requirement: **6 GHz to 2nd harmonic**。
- Limit: **-13 dBm**。
- Method: [[TRP]]。
- 在 TS8996 / TS8980 differentiation slide 中，來源稱 [[R&S TS8980 Conformance Test Platform]] with compact CATR [[R&S ATS1800C]] includes RSE **6 GHz to 92 GHz**, limit **-13 dBm/MHz** acc. 3GPP。

5G FR2 RSE 測試 › EIRP / TRP two-step method
依 [[RSE Test System TS8996 (1)]]：

- 先用 [[EIRP]] coarse grid identify spurious emission frequencies。
- EIRP limit is valid as long as max. EIRP is below TRP limit。
- 對 EIRP above the limit 的 frequencies，用 fine grid 執行 [[TRP]]。
- Grid selection for spurious emissions is up to test system implementation，但需 meet criteria。
- 來源列出的 grid points：coarse constant density 35；coarse constant step size 62（30°）；fine constant density 135；fine constant step size 266（15°）。

5G FR2 RSE 測試
[[5G FR2 RSE 測試]]是針對 5G FR2 devices 的 [[Radiated Spurious Emissions]] 測試主題；[[RSE Test System TS8996 (1)]]（07/2025）把它拆成 3GPP / FCC / ETSI requirements、TS8980 / TS8996 分工、FR2 signal conditioning、above-40-GHz extension 與 [[R&S ELEKTRA]] test workflow。

5G FR2 RSE 測試 › TS8980 與 TS8996 分工
依 [[RSE Test System TS8996 (1)]]：

- 5G FR1：[[R&S TS8980 Conformance Test Platform]] covers validated conducted 3GPP / ETSI tests；另需 radiated RSE（[[R&S TS8996]]）、EMC（[[R&S TS9982 EMS Test System]]）與 OTA（[[R&S TS8991]]）。
- 5G FR2：all tests radiated。
- 3GPP validated tests with [[R&S ATS1800C]] → [[R&S TS8980 Conformance Test Platform]]。
- ETSI / FCC broader RSE requirements → [[R&S TS8996]]。
- TS8996 被來源描述為 up to 220 GHz / 325 GHz in anechoic chamber。

Radiated Spurious Emissions › 在 R&S solution mapping 中的位置
依 [[Regulatory test for wireless devices with cellular technology]]：

- RSE 出現在 CE RED Art 3.2 radio spectrum 與 FCC wireless regulatory testing 語境。
- 來源將 [[R&S TS8996]] 列為 RSE solution mapping。
- 來源對 5G FR2 提到 RSE up to 200 GHz、high sensitivity -40 dBm/MHz、special signaling、conditioning for carrier 與 all standards support。
- RSE test can use spectrum analyzer or EMI receiver；RF analysis need spectrum analyzer，EMC test standards need EMI receiver。

依 [[RSE Test System TS8996 (1)]]：

- RSE has always to be evaluated, also for precertified modules。
- Basic RSE setup 類似 commercial EMI test。
- TS8996 supports 2G / 3G / 4G / 5G FR1 / WLAN / BT，並可擴充到 5G FR2 / above 40 GHz。
- 測試場地可為 FAR with azimuth / optional elevation scan，或 SAC with height scan。
- 常見 test distance 為 3 m；為提高 sensitivity 可使用 1 m。
- Signal conditioning 是 RSE 的關鍵，因為 high-power carrier 可能使 receiver / analyzer overload，特別是 near-carrier measurement。

Radiated Spurious Emissions › Substitution method
依 [[RSE Test System TS8996 (1)]]：

- Reference method: substitution。
- DUT replaced by calibrated antenna with signal generator。
- Signal generator level tuned to same receive value as DUT。
- EIRP calculated by adding antenna gain and cable loss。
- [[R&S ELEKTRA]] supports this method。

RSE Test System TS8996 (1) › 重點摘要
- 來源標題為 `Radited Spurious Emission (RSE) Test System TS8996`，頁尾日期標示 **07/2025**；`Radited` 為原文拼字。
- 基本 RSE setup 類似 commercial EMI test，可用 FAR 搭配 DUT azimuth 與 optional elevation scan，也可用 SAC 搭配 height scan。
- 基本頻率範圍列為 **30 MHz to 12.75 / 26 GHz / 40 GHz**，使用 spectrum analyzer 或 spectrum analyzer + test receiver；test distance 可為 **3 m**，或為提高 sensitivity 使用 **1 m**。
- 系統要求 high sensitivity、stable radiated radiocommunication link、signal conditioning，並由 [[R&S ELEKTRA]] 全自動控制。
- 來源明示 [[R&S TS8996]] 可作 turnkey solution，也可與 EMC test system 或 regulatory test system（[[R&S TS8997]]）組合 / 擴充。
- 3G / 4G / 5G FR1 的 signal conditioning 使用 [[OSP-B155G]]，頻率範圍 **30 MHz to 8 GHz**；支援 RED carrier up to **30 dBm**、FCC carrier up to **36 dBm**，並支援 5G NSA mode with 2 simultaneous carriers（LTE and 5G）。
- 1 GHz to 40 GHz 使用 [[TS-PRE2]] 與 [[TS-LNA1840]]；1–18 GHz 需 high sensitivity 與 carrier suppression，18–40 GHz 則把 receiver 放在 anechoic chamber 內並以 fiber optic 控制。
- 來源稱 typical sensitivity：TX at 3 m 可達 **-30 dBm with 12 dB S/N**（即 -42 dBm，peak detector）；RX at 1 m 可達 **-47 dBm with 12 dB S/N**（即 -59 dBm，peak detector）。
- [[R&S ELEKTRA]] 提供 RSE 專用功能：3D EIRP evaluation、ELEMI-OOB burst analysis、substitution method、SAC height-scan correction、CMW / CMX signaling、multi-band measurement。
- [[R&S ELEKTRA]] RSE option list 包含 ELEMI-EAS、ELEMI-RSE、ELEMI-3D、ELEMC-WRLS、ELEMC-CELS、ELEMC-5GS、ELEMI-5GFC、ELEMI-OOB、ELEMI-MBM、ELEMC-DRV。
- 5G FR2 section 指出 FCC / ANSI C63.26 的 RSE upper frequency 依 fundamental frequency 決定：RF signal <10 GHz 到 10th harmonic max 40 GHz；RF signal <30 GHz 到 5th harmonic max 100 GHz；RF signal >30 GHz 到 5th harmonic max 200 GHz。
- 3GPP / RAN4 對 5G FR2 的 RSE specification 為 **9 kHz to 2nd harmonic**，test requirement 為 **6 GHz to 2nd harmonic**，limit **-13 dBm**，method 為 [[TRP]]。

RSE Test System TS8996 (1) › 重點摘要
- FCC 47 CFR Part 30 / KDB 842590 / ANSI C63.26 對 5G FR2 的來源說法為 **30 MHz up to 5th harmonic / 100 GHz or 200 GHz**，limit **-13 dBm**，method 為 [[TRP]]，並提到 EIRP early exit criteria。
- ETSI 301 908-25 draft covers 5G FR2 RSE，依 ERC Recommendation 74-01（1998, amended 29 May 2019），並列出 30 MHz to 1 GHz、1 GHz to 7.25 GHz、7.25 GHz to 2nd harmonic 的 TRP limits。
- 來源把 [[R&S TS8980 Conformance Test Platform]] 與 [[R&S TS8996]] 做區分：FR1 中 TS8980 負責 validated conducted tests，另需 radiated RSE（TS8996）、EMC（TS9982）、OTA（TS8991）；FR2 中 3GPP validated tests with ATS1800C 屬 TS8980，而 ETSI / FCC 額外 RSE 需求屬 TS8996。
- 來源稱 TS8980 with compact CATR ATS1800C includes RSE 6 GHz to 92 GHz, limit -13 dBm/MHz acc. 3GPP；而 [[R&S TS8996]] up to **220 GHz / 325 GHz** in anechoic chamber。
- 5G FR2 signal conditioning 18–50 GHz 使用 [[TS-PRE1850]]，18–40 GHz base，40–50 GHz extension with antenna [[TS-PRE-B1]]，可同時測 spurious 與 carrier。
- 41–325 GHz system extension 包含 receive units [[TC-RSE60]]、[[TC-RSE90]]、[[TC-RSE140]]、[[TC-RSE220]]、[[TC-RSE325]] 與 multiplier units [[TC-MX60]]、[[TC-MX90]]、[[TC-MX140]]、[[TC-MX220]]、[[TC-MX325]]，並以 [[OSP220]]、[[R&S ESW44]] with B21、[[R&S SMB100A]]、[[R&S CMX500]]、[[R&S ELEKTRA]] 組成系統。
- TC-RSE units 的 sensitivity EIRP 來源標示為 **< -40 dBm/MHz**（RMS detector）at **1 m** test distance。
- 5G FR2 ELEKTRA procedure 包含 overview measurement、data reduction、maximization、adjustment、final measurement，並支援 virtual RMS detector with 100 MHz / 200 MHz bandwidth。

RSE Test System TS8996 (1) › 原文未解的問題
- 來源為 PowerPoint lossy derivative，圖片與表格可能因 OCR / conversion 造成拼字或欄位錯位；原始 pptx 才是 source of truth。
- 來源未提供 TS8996 formal datasheet、order number、完整 BOM、可交付 option structure、系統 uncertainty budget 或 calibration interval。
- 來源未列 [[R&S ELEKTRA]] software version、正式 option order number、license dependencies 或 release note。
- `ETSI 301 908-25 (draft)` 未標示 draft version、發布日期或後續是否已 harmonized。
- FCC Part 30、KDB 842590、ANSI C63.26 與 47 CFR §2.1057 / Part 30 的正式版本未標示。
- `TS8996 up to 220 GHz / 325 GHz` 來源是簡報說法；需正式 system documentation 確認可交付 configuration、frequency bands、uncertainty 與 calibration method。
- TC-RSE / TC-MX modules、TS-PRE1850、TS-PRE-B1、OSP-B155G、TS-PRE2、TS-LNA1840、OSP220、OSP-B153B 的正式料號、datasheet 與相容性未標示。
- Slide 29 的 `Test distance ≥ 2D2/` 顯然缺少公式分母或上標，需回查原投影片或 FCC rule。
- Slide 30 / 31 的 ETSI 301 908-25 draft limits 與 grid points 需要以正式標準確認。
- Slide 36 出現兩列 n261，其中第二列 47.2–48.2 GHz 可能應為其他 band；不可未查證即修正。

FCC 無線設備法規測試 › 5G FR2 RSE requirement 口徑
依 [[RSE Test System TS8996 (1)]]（07/2025）：

- ANSI C63.26 RSE Frequency Ranges USA：
  - RF signal <10 GHz: 10th harmonic, max. 40 GHz。
  - RF signal <30 GHz: 5th harmonic, max. 100 GHz。
  - RF signal >30 GHz: 5th harmonic, max. 200 GHz。
- FCC 47 CFR Part 30, KDB 842590 and ANSI C63.26：
  - 30 MHz up to 5th harmonic / 100 GHz（devices <30 GHz）, 200 GHz（devices >30 GHz）。
  - Limit -13 dBm。
  - Method: [[TRP]]。
  - Early exit criteria for [[EIRP]], TRP only for failing frequencies。
  - Test distance 公式在轉檔中顯示為 `≥ 2D2/`，不完整，需回查原投影片或 FCC / ANSI 原文。
- 同來源在 TS8996 / TS8980 differentiation 中說 FCC requires 30 MHz to 5th harmonic / 200 GHz and semi anechoic chamber → [[R&S TS8996]]。

⚠️ [[RSE Test System TS8996 (1)]]（07/2025）說 FCC 5G FR2 RSE requirement starts at 30 MHz up to 5th harmonic / 100 GHz or 200 GHz，但既有頁面 [[FCC 無線設備法規測試]] 說 5G NR FR2 FCC analyzer frequency range 是 9 kHz–200 GHz。判斷：兩者可能分別是 test requirement lower bound 與 analyzer / general spectrum investigation range 口徑；未回查 47 CFR、KDB 842590 與 ANSI C63.26 前並列保留。

GFM313_3e_5G_NR_BaseStation_Tx_Tests › 6.6.4 Operating band unwanted emissions（OBUE / SEM）
- Spectrum Emission Mask（SEM）測試要求適用 Category A 或 Category B。
- 最低強制要求見 [[3GPP TS 38.141-1]] subclause 6.6.4.5。
- SEM 測試中，DUT 以 declared rated output power 發射。
- SEM 測試需要使用 test models NR-FR1-TM1.1 與 NR-FR1-TM1.2。
- TDD signal 的 SEM 測試 trigger 必須設定為 external。
- SEM 量測可使用 FSW 的 `CONFigure[:NR5G]:MEASurement ESPectrum` 與 `CALCulate<n>:MARKer<m>:FUNCtion:POWer<sb>:RESult[:CURRent]? [<Measurement>]` 等 SCPI command。

GFM313_3e_5G_NR_BaseStation_Tx_Tests › Rohde & Schwarz 公司資訊
來源末尾描述：

- Rohde & Schwarz electronics group 提供 test and measurement、broadcast and media、secure communications、cybersecurity、monitoring and network testing 解決方案。
- Rohde & Schwarz 成立超過 80 年，總部位於 Munich, Germany。
- Rohde & Schwarz 在超過 70 個國家設有 sales and service network。
- 資料未含 tolerance limits 時不具 binding；subject to change。
- © 2021 Rohde & Schwarz GmbH & Co. KG。

GFM313_3e_5G_NR_BaseStation_Tx_Tests › 6.4 Transmit ON/OFF power
- Transmit OFF power requirements 僅適用於 NR BS 的 TDD operation。
- Transmitter OFF power 定義為 transmitter OFF period 期間，使用 bandwidth 等於 BS transmission bandwidth configuration（BWconfig）且 centered on assigned channel frequency 的 square filter，於 70/N μs 內量測的 mean power。
- N = SCS/15，其中 SCS 為 kHz 單位。
- Transmitter OFF power limit：f ≤ 3.0 GHz 為 -83.0 dBm/MHz；3.0 GHz < f ≤ 6.0 GHz 為 -82.5 dBm/MHz。
- 測試需要 RF limiter 限制 transmitter ON periods 期間 analyzer 接收的 power，使 OFF periods 量測可使用 full dynamic range。
- 可額外使用 attenuator 吸收 limiter reflected power，以最佳化 VSWR。

SCPI 摘錄：

- `CONFigure[:NR5G]:MEASurement TPOO`
- `[SENSe:]FREQuency:CENTer <Frequency>`
- `[SENSe:]NR5G:OOPower:NCORrection <State>`
- `UNIT:OPOWer <Unit>`
- `TRAC6:DATA? LIST`

GFM313_3e_5G_NR_BaseStation_Tx_Tests › BS type 1-H
- FR1 hybrid type。
- 具有兩個 reference points，同時滿足 radiated 與 conducted requirements。
- conducted characteristics 定義於 [[TAB]]（transceiver array boundary）。
- [[TAB]] 是 transceiver unit array 與 composite antenna 之間的 conducted interface，具備 conducted measurements 用 connectors。
- 此 Application Note 的所有 test cases 適用於 [[TAB]] 的 conducted measurements。
- radiated characteristics 定義於 [[RIB]]（radiated interface boundary），以 OTA 量測。
- OTA specific requirements 與 test cases 定義於 [[3GPP TS 38.141-2]]。

GFM313_3e_5G_NR_BaseStation_Tx_Tests › Manual operation 共通流程
來源說多數測試共用相同初始步驟：

- 執行任何測試前，建議按下儀器前面板 PRESET 鍵，將儀器 reset 至 default state。
- 某些量測需透過 external reference 將 FSW 同步至 high precision time reference。
- 使用 external reference 時，需將 external reference signal 接至後面板 reference input，並將 reference frequency input 改為 External Reference。
- FSW 前面板可透過 SETUP key → sidebar 選 Reference → popup list 選 External Reference：10 MHz、1…50 MHz、100 MHz、1 GHz。

單次量測控制位於 front panel Function Keys：

- RUN SINGLE：開始新的 single-shot measurement，量測後停止 acquisition。
- RUN CONT：開始 continuous / repetitive measurements。

不同 BS transmitter tests 需要不同 operation mode：

- Spectrum mode。
- 5G NR mode。

Spectrum mode 量測用途：

- Occupied bandwidth（OBW）：對應 6.6.2。
- Transmitter spurious emissions：對應 6.6.5。

5G NR mode 量測用途：

- EVM/Frequency Err/Power：用於 Base station output power（6.2）、Frequency error（6.5.2）、Modulation quality（6.5.3）。
- Time Alignment Error：用於 TAE（6.5.4）。
- Transmit ON/OFF Power：用於 Transmit on/off power（6.4）。
- Channel Power ACLR：用於 ACLR（6.6.3）。
- SEM：用於 OBUE（6.6.4）。

FSW 5G NR signal analysis overview-screen 可設定：Deployment、Channel bandwidth、Test model、Center-frequency、Reference level、FSW attenuation。

Drone EMC 測試 › Immunity level 與 application-dependent test level
[[2025RS Drone Solution]] 引用 [[EN 301 489-1]] immunity requirements：

- default test level：3 V/m。
- frequency range：80 MHz to 6 GHz。

來源同時提出問題：`Is this test level adequate for all environment?`，並以 recreational / photography、delivery / mapping / surveying、powerline / infrastructure inspection 對應 default test level、higher test level（10 V/m）與 specialized test level。

使用限制：來源沒有把這些 application 與固定測試等級一一正式規範化；它明示 test level needs to be defined by drone manufacturer according to applications。

Drone EMC 測試 › Drone components 與 EUT
[[2025RS Drone Solution]] 在 drone issue 頁列出 safety / EMC 關聯元件：

- [[Battery]]。
- [[Battery Management System]] / [[BMS]]。
- [[Electric Steering Controller]] / [[ESC]]。
- [[Flight Control Module]] / [[FCM]]。
- [[Communication Module]] / [[CM]]。
- antennas and sensors。

來源沒有提供具體 EUT 型號、BOM、電壓、介面或測試 setup；因此本頁只記錄這些是測試風險與待測元件線索。

Drone EMC 測試
[[Drone EMC 測試]] 是針對 drone / [[UAV]] / [[UAS]] 在預期操作環境中對 electromagnetic emissions 與 electromagnetic immunity 的符合性與可靠性驗證。

Drone EMC 測試 › Commercial drone EMC 風險
依 [[2025RS Drone Solution]]，commercial drones heavy reliance on electronic components；failure result 可能包含 drone malfunction、drone crash、property damage、injury、consumer confidence decline 及其他 implications。

來源將 commercial drone EMC 與 regulatory compliance、safety、reliability 相連，並連到 [[European EMC Directive]] 2014/30/EU 與 [[Radio Equipment Directive]] 2014/53/EU。

Time Domain Channel Properties
[[Time Domain Channel Properties]]（TDCP）是 [[Release 18]] 中用於描述 channel time-domain behavior、[[UE]] relative mobility 與 associated Doppler 的新 measurement / CSI-related quantity，可協助 [[gNB]] 在 high-speed scenarios 中調整 transmission configuration。[[R18 CSI enhancements for high-speed Scenario]] [[TDCP Reporting]]

3GPP TS 38.215 › unresolved
- 需補 [[3GPP TS 38.215]] 的正式題名、發布組織、version、release 與發布日期。
- 需確認 TDCP definition 的 exact clause 與 wording。
- 需確認 [[TDCP report]] 是否在 38.215 僅定義 measurement，或也牽涉 report interpretation。

### Short answer
The passages use “measurement method” as the concrete way a test result is obtained: the raw source labels the test method as “Measurement” for an “expected nominal power setting for full dynamic range,” while RSE examples spell out methods such as substitution, EIRP coarse-grid search, and TRP fine-grid/final evaluation [100][37][8][44].
### What the method can mean in these passages
| Measurement-method concept | What the passages state |
|---|---|
| Substitution method | For RSE, the reference method is substitution: the DUT is replaced by a calibrated antenna with a signal generator, the generator level is tuned to the same receive value as the DUT, and EIRP is calculated by adding antenna gain and cable loss [37]. |
| EIRP / TRP method | R&S ELEKTRA supports 3D EIRP evaluation by measuring Effective Isotropic Radiated Power instead of field strength, while 5G FR2 sources often express the test requirement using TRP [8]. |
| Two-step EIRP→TRP method | The 5G FR2 RSE two-step method first uses an EIRP coarse grid to identify spurious frequencies, then performs TRP on a fine grid for frequencies where EIRP is above the limit [44]. |
| Raw product-test label | One raw passage only states “Expected nominal power setting for full dynamic range / Test method / Measurement,” without giving a fuller definition [100]. |
### Product-related measurement decisions that depend on understanding it
| Decision | Why the measurement method matters | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Whether to use ELEKTRA 3D EIRP / ELEMI-3D | ELEMI-3D is tied to measuring EIRP instead of field strength, supporting SAC and FAR 3D measurement, elevation positioner, spherical elevation or cylindrical height scan, and 3D result presentation [1]. | [1] |
| Whether substitution support is needed in ELEKTRA | ELEKTRA supports the RSE substitution method, whose procedure replaces the DUT with a calibrated antenna and signal generator and calculates EIRP from antenna gain and cable loss [37]. | [37] |
| Whether the RSE result should be EIRP or TRP | The passages distinguish 3D EIRP evaluation from FR2 RSE requirements often expressed as TRP, and describe final measurements that can calculate 2-cut TRP, 3-cut TRP, or full TRP [8]. | [8] |
| Whether to use TS8980 or TS8996 for FR2 RSE scope | For 5G FR2, 3GPP validated tests with R&S ATS1800C are mapped to R&S TS8980, while broader ETSI / FCC RSE requirements are mapped to R&S TS8996 [46]. | [46] |
| Which chamber / scan setup to use in TS8996-style RSE | RSE setup can use FAR with azimuth and optional elevation scan, or SAC with height scan; common test distance is 3 m, and 1 m can be used to improve sensitivity [47]. | [47] |
| Whether to use a spectrum analyzer or EMI receiver | The passages state that RSE can use a spectrum analyzer or EMI receiver, RF analysis needs a spectrum analyzer, and EMC test standards need an EMI receiver [47][56]. | [47][56] |
| Which FSW operating mode to choose for base-station Tx tests | Spectrum mode is used for OBW and transmitter spurious emissions, while 5G NR mode is used for EVM/Frequency Err/Power, Time Alignment Error, Transmit ON/OFF Power, Channel Power ACLR, and SEM [79]. | [79] |
| Whether to apply virtual RMS detector bandwidths | ELEKTRA supports virtual RMS detectors with 100 MHz and 200 MHz bandwidth that integrate lower-bandwidth measurements over a sliding window for FR2 RSE limits [3][5]. | [3][5] |

R&S ELEKTRA › 3D EIRP Evaluation / ELEMI-3D
依 [[RSE Test System TS8996 (1)]]：

- 量測 [[EIRP]]（Effective Isotropic Radiated Power）instead of field strength。
- 支援 SAC and FAR 3D measurement。
- 支援 elevation positioner。
- 支援 spherical elevation 或 cylindrical height scan。
- 支援 3D result presentation。
- option 名稱為 [[ELEMI-3D]]。

R&S ELEKTRA › 5G FR2 test procedure support
依 [[RSE Test System TS8996 (1)]]：

- ELEKTRA is next generation EMC test SW。
- For 5G support of RSE measurement procedures with extension for 5G FR2。
- 支援 3D and TRP evaluation。
- 支援 5G signaling with [[R&S CMX500]]。
- Mixers and calibration procedure also supported by EMC32。
- EMI test sequence adopted to support RSE requirements。
- Sweeps 可 free run（for FDD）或 gated sweep（triggered by CMX, for TDD）。
- 支援 elevation positioner。
- 支援 3D view possibility for overview measurement, maximization and final TRP measurement。
- Typical test distance: **1 m for >40 GHz** and **3 m for <40 GHz**。
- Workflow steps 包含 overview measurement、data reduction、maximization、adjustment、final measurement。
- Virtual RMS detectors with **100 MHz and 200 MHz bandwidth** 可把 lower bandwidth measurement integration over 100 MHz / 200 MHz sliding window，用於平行量測 -13 dBm/MHz 與 -10 dBm/100 MHz limits。

5G FR2 RSE 測試 › ELEKTRA workflow
依 [[RSE Test System TS8996 (1)]]：

1. Overview measurement：scan over complete sphere, wide frequency subrange, continuous azimuth / elevation, V / H polarisation。
2. Data reduction：detect critical frequencies，limit check，例如 FCC 20 dB below limit (-33 dBm/MHz) as early pass / fail criteria。
3. Maximization：high-resolution maximum EIRP search over complete sphere。
4. Adjustment：loop over azimuth, elevation, polarization H / V / +45° / -45°, x-y variation of test antenna。
5. Final measurement：2 orthogonal cuts, 3rd orthogonal cut, 2-cut / 3-cut TRP, if limit exceeded full TRP。

[[R&S ELEKTRA]] also supports virtual RMS detectors with 100 MHz and 200 MHz bandwidth, integrating lower-bandwidth measurements over a sliding window for ETSI -10 dBm/100 MHz limit.

Radiated Spurious Emissions › RSE 與 EIRP / TRP
依 [[RSE Test System TS8996 (1)]]：

- [[R&S ELEKTRA]] 支援 3D [[EIRP]] evaluation：量測 Effective Isotropic Radiated Power instead of field strength。
- 5G FR2 來源多以 [[TRP]] method 表示 test requirement。
- ETSI 301 908-25 draft 來源描述 two-step method：先用 EIRP coarse grid 找 spurious frequencies，再對 EIRP above limit 的 frequencies 執行 TRP fine grid。
- Final measurement 可計算 2-cut TRP、3-cut TRP；若 limit exceeded，另執行 full TRP。

R&S ELEKTRA › Substitution method
依來源：

- RSE measurement including substitution 的 reference method 為 substitution。
- DUT replaced by a calibrated antenna with signal generator。
- Signal generator level tuned to same receive value as DUT。
- EIRP calculated by adding antenna gain and cable loss。
- Supported by ELEKTRA。

5G FR2 RSE 測試 › EIRP / TRP two-step method
依 [[RSE Test System TS8996 (1)]]：

- 先用 [[EIRP]] coarse grid identify spurious emission frequencies。
- EIRP limit is valid as long as max. EIRP is below TRP limit。
- 對 EIRP above the limit 的 frequencies，用 fine grid 執行 [[TRP]]。
- Grid selection for spurious emissions is up to test system implementation，但需 meet criteria。
- 來源列出的 grid points：coarse constant density 35；coarse constant step size 62（30°）；fine constant density 135；fine constant step size 266（15°）。

5G FR2 RSE 測試 › TS8980 與 TS8996 分工
依 [[RSE Test System TS8996 (1)]]：

- 5G FR1：[[R&S TS8980 Conformance Test Platform]] covers validated conducted 3GPP / ETSI tests；另需 radiated RSE（[[R&S TS8996]]）、EMC（[[R&S TS9982 EMS Test System]]）與 OTA（[[R&S TS8991]]）。
- 5G FR2：all tests radiated。
- 3GPP validated tests with [[R&S ATS1800C]] → [[R&S TS8980 Conformance Test Platform]]。
- ETSI / FCC broader RSE requirements → [[R&S TS8996]]。
- TS8996 被來源描述為 up to 220 GHz / 325 GHz in anechoic chamber。

Radiated Spurious Emissions › 在 R&S solution mapping 中的位置
依 [[Regulatory test for wireless devices with cellular technology]]：

- RSE 出現在 CE RED Art 3.2 radio spectrum 與 FCC wireless regulatory testing 語境。
- 來源將 [[R&S TS8996]] 列為 RSE solution mapping。
- 來源對 5G FR2 提到 RSE up to 200 GHz、high sensitivity -40 dBm/MHz、special signaling、conditioning for carrier 與 all standards support。
- RSE test can use spectrum analyzer or EMI receiver；RF analysis need spectrum analyzer，EMC test standards need EMI receiver。

依 [[RSE Test System TS8996 (1)]]：

- RSE has always to be evaluated, also for precertified modules。
- Basic RSE setup 類似 commercial EMI test。
- TS8996 supports 2G / 3G / 4G / 5G FR1 / WLAN / BT，並可擴充到 5G FR2 / above 40 GHz。
- 測試場地可為 FAR with azimuth / optional elevation scan，或 SAC with height scan。
- 常見 test distance 為 3 m；為提高 sensitivity 可使用 1 m。
- Signal conditioning 是 RSE 的關鍵，因為 high-power carrier 可能使 receiver / analyzer overload，特別是 near-carrier measurement。

FCC 無線設備法規測試 › RED / FCC frequency range 對照
依 [[Regulatory test for wireless devices with cellular technology]]，來源引用 [[ITU-R SM.329-12]] 與 §2.1057，列出 regulatory / analyzer frequency range：

| Technology | CE RED | FCC |
|---|---|---|
| 5G NR FR1 | 30 MHz – 26 GHz | 9 kHz – 40 GHz |
| 5G NR FR2 | 30 MHz – 90 GHz | 9 kHz – 200 GHz |
| Wi-Fi | 30 MHz – 26 GHz | 9 kHz – 40 GHz |
| UWB | 30 MHz – 26 GHz | 9 kHz < 40 GHz，括號另列 100 GHz |

來源指出 RF analysis need spectrum analyzer，EMC test standards need test EMI receiver，RSE test can use both types of instrument；並列出 [[R&S FSV3000]] / [[R&S FSVA3000]]、[[R&S FSW]]、[[R&S ESW]]。

- RUN SINGLE：開始新的 single-shot measurement，量測後停止 acquisition。
- RUN CONT：開始 continuous / repetitive measurements。

- Spectrum mode。
- 5G NR mode。

- Occupied bandwidth（OBW）：對應 6.6.2。
